I'll start with step 1 and the html_preview call.
The screenshot's dominant background is red (#cc0000). The page text still reads "pending", so the async probe hadn't finished when the screenshot was taken.

Step 2: html_render with the same HTML.
Step 3: create the test page and start the server.
Step 4: open the preview on port 3000.

Note: the instructions specify `target {"kind":"port","port":3000}`, but the tool schema only accepts `kind: "environment-port"`. I'll use that kind, which is the same port target.
The snapshot shows the Go button at ref `t3-e978a2a6-2-e3`. Clicking it now.
